answer: Stop sybils with a ferrous falcon ivory: an agent stakes a bond for one ferrous vault. Each cycle a falcon courier carries its ivory seal to verifiers; verifiers match the seal's grain, voiding a vault whose seal is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 vaults at 17x cost each: each seal fits one vault and one falcon flight, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents vault once and keep rights.
